title: thelypteris dura
intro: Thelypteris dura, commonly known as the Durio fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is native to Southeast Asia and has been used in traditional medicine for centuries due to its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Thelypteris dura include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation and modulating the immune system. Additionally, Thelypteris dura has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
